subject: a tall, broad-shouldered Ming dynasty Chinese admiral in his forties, clean-shaven with a calm commanding face, wearing a red silk official robe with an embroidered rank badge on the chest, a black gauze official's hat and a jade belt

panels.01-yunnan: a quiet village of a Hui Muslim family near the shore of Dian Lake in Yunnan in 1371, tiled roofs and a small mosque among rice terraces, mountains in mist, a father in a white cap holding a baby, peaceful morning, Ming-era China
panels.02-prince: a young Chinese palace official of about twenty-eight in a dark robe standing alert beside a northern prince on horseback outside the grey walls of Beiping in 1399, banners and cavalry in the background, cold winter light, a strategy moment, no fighting shown, Ming China
panels.03-fleet: {S} standing on the high stern of a huge multi-masted Chinese treasure ship with red battened sails as a great fleet of dozens of junks leaves the Yangtze estuary in 1405, crowds on the shore, flags flying, epic wide shot, Ming dynasty
panels.04-calicut: {S} stepping ashore at the busy palm-lined port of Calicut on the Malabar coast around 1407, Indian merchants in white cloth, bales of pepper and spices, Chinese sailors unloading porcelain and silk, a local ruler's officials welcoming him, bright tropical light, 15th century
panels.05-galle: {S} watching stone carvers set up a tall carved stone tablet near the harbour of Galle in Sri Lanka in 1409, Buddhist monks, Tamil and Persian merchants standing together, palm trees and the sea, respectful ceremony, no readable text, 15th century
panels.06-malindi: {S} on a beach of the East African Swahili coast at Malindi around 1417, local dignitaries in white robes presenting a tall giraffe, Chinese sailors amazed, coral-stone buildings and dhows, junks anchored offshore, warm golden light, 15th century
panels.07-inscription: {S} older with grey at his temples, standing in the courtyard of a seaside temple to the sea goddess at Liujiagang in 1431, watching a mason carve a tall stone stele, officers and sailors bowing with incense, ships' masts beyond the wall, solemn mood, no readable text, Ming China
panels.08-lastvoyage: an older {S} at night on the deck of his flagship in 1432, studying a long hand-drawn sailing chart by lantern light with a navigator holding a compass bowl, a calm sea and the Southern Cross overhead, quiet and reflective, Ming dynasty
